items.claim: Saidyokub slowed down and failed to output significant volume in his UFC debut against Nicolas Dalby.
items.quote: He just lost his UFC debut against Nicolas Dalby because he kind of slowed down, didn't do [ __ ] 20 significant strikes in that entire fight.

items.claim: Vagayev has strong cardio and will fight for a full 15 minutes without slowing down.
items.quote: I went through Vagayev's fight tape and that dude has cardio. He will fight for a full 15 minutes and he doesn't really slow down.

items.claim: Tyrell Fortune and Rizvan Kuniev are slow, lumbering heavyweights.
Rizvan Kuniev typically wants to offensively wrestle in his fights.
items.quote: Typically, he wants to offensively wrestle.

items.claim: Rizvan Kuniev has not shown his offensive wrestling in the UFC because he has fought two wrestlers in Curtis Blaydes and Jailton Almeida.
items.quote: We haven't seen that in the UFC because he has fought two wrestlers. Curtis Blaydes, big, very good wrestler. Jailton Almeida, big, very good wrestler.
